settings.heading: Simple, transparent pricing.
settings.text: Three packages for the most common projects, and custom quotes for everything else.

settings.title: Starter Website
settings.text: A professional one-page website to present your offer.
settings.features:
Professionally designed landing page
Mobile, tablet and desktop ready
Call and WhatsApp buttons
Contact form

settings.title: Professional Website

settings.features:
Multi-page business website
Services, about and contact pages

Mobile, tablet and desktop ready

settings.title: Premium E-commerce
settings.text: A Shopify store that is ready to sell your products.
settings.features:
Shopify store setup

settings.question: Which package should I choose?
settings.answer: Starter suits a single offer or campaign. Professional presents your whole business across several pages. Premium E-commerce is for selling products online with Shopify. If you are unsure, contact us and we will advise you.

settings.question: What if my project does not fit a package?
settings.answer: Send us your requirements through the contact form. We will discuss the project with you and prepare a detailed custom quote.

settings.question: How do we get started?
settings.answer: Fill in the contact form or message us on WhatsApp. We will ask a few questions about your business and confirm the scope before starting.

settings.heading: Have a project in mind?
settings.text: Tell us about your business and we will come back with a clear proposal.
